scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Welcome to ^8B4513Brasilis^000000, a country as passionate as the sun.
If you have any questions, please ask me.
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
欢迎来到^8B4513巴西^000000，一个如太阳般热情的国度。
如果您有任何问题，请随时问我。

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Where can I guide you?

[Brasilis Guide]
The Brasilis Hotel is located just above, ^FF3355+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
巴西酒店就在上方，^FF3355+^000000。
还有什么我可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Do you want to go through the rough jungle? You can take a 
Jungle Cable here ^CE6300+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
您想穿越崎岖的丛林吗？您可以乘坐这里的丛林缆车 ^CE6300+^000000。
还有什么我可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
The pride of Brasilis, the world scale Art Museum is at ^A5BAAD+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
巴西的骄傲，世界级的艺术博物馆位于 ^A5BAAD+^000000。
还有什么我可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
You can buy items for hunting at the Market here ^55FF33+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
您可以在这里的市场 ^55FF33+^000000 购买狩猎所需的物品。
还有什么我可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
The iconic monument of Brasilis, the Verass Monument stands at ^3355FF+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
巴西的标志性建筑，维拉斯纪念碑矗立在 ^3355FF+^000000。
还有什么我可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
I'll remove all marks from your mini-map.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
我将清除您小地图上的所有标记。
还有什么我可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Wandering on your own is always the best way to explore. Anyway, take care.
scripts.translation:
[巴西向导]
独自探索总是最好的方式。总之，请多保重。
